maxPages.title: Max listing pages
maxPages.description: How many pages of the workatastartup marketing listing to scan. The board rarely has more than one real page.

fetchDetail.title: Fetch full job detail
fetchDetail.description: Also open each job page for full description, salary/equity, min experience, skills, and founder names + LinkedIns. Slower but much richer.

includeDirector.title: Include Director-level titles
includeDirector.description: By default 'Director' titles are excluded as too senior. Turn on to keep them.

activeWithinDays.title: Company active within N days
activeWithinDays.description: Keep jobs whose company was active in the last N days. Note: workatastartup exposes this only sometimes, so it is a weak signal today.

strictRecency.title: Strict recency
strictRecency.description: Also drop jobs that have no company-activity date at all. Leaving this off keeps them.

limit.title: Max jobs
limit.description: Optional cap on the number of jobs pushed to the dataset.
